SA025-AUDIT20261026-1: This is a separate deliberate rail restriction, not a reason to include SA025-D1. UNB and the Daily Star report Benapole rail-goods restoration on September 4 and describe 47 days since July 19. However, the August 19 Daily Star report already records Indian Railways’ verbal decision for freight restoration the following day; a later New Age official account dates wider freight restoration to August 20, and the September 8 Times of India mentions rakes dispatched during the preceding two weeks. These are not fully reconciled at the Benapole gate level. September 4 is therefore retained as confirmed access by that date, not an uncontested first reopening. The confirmed pre-restoration span ends August 19; no uninterrupted closure is assumed afterwards. Passenger trains remained a distinct restriction and are not assigned the freight endpoint.
